key_notes: Key 1 (t=1.56s): Initial archival pose of octopus; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=2.69s): Mid-sequence articulation of octopus; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=3.92s): Peak dynamic extension of octopus over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=5.16s): Follow-through and settle of octopus with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of octopus (1.56s..5.16s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
